title: Campaign templates
description: Reusable email templates, one per campaign type and language

help.title: About Campaign templates
help.overview: The emails your campaigns send, written once and reused. Write one for each campaign type, in each language you need.

sections.title: How a template works
items: Write the subject, the preview text and the body. Words in braces, such as {firstName}, are filled in for each recipient.
Give translations the same title and type: each recipient then gets the version in their language when there is one.
Every email gets a greeting and an unsubscribe link for you, so leave them out of the body.

sections.title: On this page
items: Open a template to see how the email looks.
Use template starts a new campaign with it.
Deactivate a template you no longer use: campaigns can't send with an inactive template.
